condition.title: Branch conditions
condition.hint: Set the condition for entering this branch. When multiple branches match, the first one from the top takes priority.
condition.name: Branch name
condition.removeHint: Keep at least one condition. Remove downstream nodes and configuration before deleting a branch.
condition.fallbackHint: Use this path when no condition matches. It always stays last.

operatorHints.equals: Use this branch when the field matches the condition value.
operatorHints.notEquals: Use this branch when the field differs from the condition value.
operatorHints.isEmpty: Use this branch when the field is not filled in. No condition value is needed.
operatorHints.isNotEmpty: Use this branch when the field is filled in. No condition value is needed.
operatorHints.greaterThan: Compare the amount, number or date with the condition value.
operatorHints.greaterThanOrEqual: Compare the amount, number or date with the condition value.
operatorHints.lessThan: Compare the amount, number or date with the condition value.
operatorHints.lessThanOrEqual: Compare the amount, number or date with the condition value.

condition.staleFieldTypeHint: The field type has changed or this rule is not bound yet. Rebind the field and enter the condition again before publishing.

approval.anyHint: The first submitted approval or rejection decides the result. Other approvers no longer need to act.

approval.sequentialHint: Approvers decide in the configured order. Everyone must approve; any rejection ends this step.

positions.hint: Uses the primary department captured at submission. Current holders of the selected positions are resolved when this step is reached. Sequential approval follows the selected position order.
positions.unavailableCount: Unavailable positions: {count}. Select active positions before publishing.

status.error: Positions could not be loaded. Saved selections are retained.
status.forbidden: You do not have permission to view positions.

approval.operationsHint: Choose which additional operations approvers may use at this step.

hierarchy.continuous: Include every level up to the selected level

missingAssignee.title: When no reviewer is available
missingAssignee.hint: Applies when the source has no eligible reviewer. Configuration errors still block the request.

roles.label: Approval roles
